verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official Spline command-line tool. The bundled MCP server, the desktop app, the Code API runtime npm package and the code exports are different capabilities and earn no credit toward a CLI. A design tool like Spline could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
